question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: She insisted **me to take the medicine.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**that I take the medicine**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The verb "**insisted**" is generally followed by the structure "**that + subject + base verb**."
 
• In this case, the correct structure is "**She insisted that I take the medicine**."
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect because they do not follow the correct verb structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"She insisted that I take the medicine."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "me that I take medicine"** is incorrect because the pronoun "me" is wrongly placed before the clause.
 
• **Option 3: "me taking the medicine"** is incorrect because it does not follow the correct structure after "insisted."
 
• **Option 4: "to take medicine by me"** is incorrect because it uses a passive construction that is unnatural in this context.
